austin.summary: Austin, you sat at the back of the snake at pick 5 and somehow walked out with a full house — four drafted, 4 of 4 still in the game, 4 counted points, and a share of rank 1 of 5. A draft GPA of 3.75, a clean +4 in Ep 1, and Eric grabbed at pick #16. There are 110 points still on the table and the leader has 4. You're right in it.

bullets.label: Carrying the load
bullets.text: Nobody's carrying anybody yet — Linnea, Jenna, Carter and Eric are each sitting on 1 pts and each ranked 1 of 21, a perfectly balanced four-way split of your 4 counted points.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Linnea's B grade is the lone blemish on an otherwise straight-A board, and three of your four — Linnea, Carter and Eric — are stacked together on Savu, so that tribe's fortunes are very much your fortunes.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Watch Jenna on Toka, your only player outside the Savu bloc — the strategist who's been planning this since she was seven is the one storyline that runs independent of the rest of your roster.

kylie.summary: Kylie, you took the first punch of this season — Aaliyah went home Ep 1, and that First Blood badge is yours forever. But look closer: you've still got 3 of 4 in the game, three counted points, and your best week is Ep 1 at +3. Yes, you sit rank 5 of 5, but the leader has 4 and there are 85 points still on the table. That is not a hole. That is a running start.

bullets.text: Cristian, Alexis and Kilby are all sitting at 1 pts and tied at rank 1 of 21 — three A grades pulling in perfect lockstep.

bullets.label: Cause for concern
bullets.text: Aaliyah at pick #3 was the reach that stung, finishing rank 21 of 21 with 0 pts and a grade F after being the first voted out.

bullets.label: Watch for
bullets.text: Kilby at pick #18 is your steal of the draft — a game designer thinking three steps ahead on Toka, and how far he climbs may decide how fast you close that one-point gap.
